acceptance_criteria.description: Every unit source_run_id resolves to exactly one HistoricalRun in the same source and experiment.
Unit and run canonical experiment condition digests match exactly.
Missing, ambiguous, cross-experiment, and drifted references fail deterministically.
Existing checked-in import identities and projections remain unchanged.
Focused tests and repository validation pass with exact results reported.

objective: Fail closed unless each unit result resolves to one same-source same-experiment run with identical frozen experiment conditions.
title: Validate historical unit results against source runs
